name: Husqvarna 555
blurb: 16″–24″ bars on 3/8″ chain, .050″ and .058″ gauge, 60–84 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 bar and chain fit-up guide.
intro: The 555 is a professional rear-handle saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists 8 bar and chain combinations for the 555: 16″, 18″, 20″, 24″. Pitch on those rows: 3/8″. Gauge: .050″ and .058″. More than one gauge is approved, so the groove stamped on the bar decides the chain. Match pitch, gauge and drive links to the bar-tail stamp before you order.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687260 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550060.
